content.comment_body: While installing [product_name] Web Editor, the installation was interrupted by a popup message indicating that the JVM was not compatible. Though I have already installed Java 8 (latest update), this issue still arises. Any suggestions on the cause, or information about a newer version of [product_name] Web Editor?
I am currently using Java 8 Update 301, and for me, [product_name] Web Editor version [version_no] is functioning properly.

analysis.insight_summary: There appears to be a compatibility problem between [product_name] Web Editor and the installed Java environment. One user is unable to complete installation due to JVM incompatibility, even with Java 8 updates, while another reports successful operation with Java 8 Update 301 and the same editor version. This suggests inconsistencies in Java compatibility or environment requirements, leading to user confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Web Editor to work reliably with Java 8 as stated, and seek confirmation about the most recent compatible version to avoid installation issues.
